title: User Login & Credential Verification
want: securely log in with my username and password
soThat: I can access my authorized academic portal

title: User Logout & Session Invalidation
want: log out securely from active sessions
soThat: my account cannot be compromised on shared computers

title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
want: enforce strict role permissions across Admin, Faculty, and Students
soThat: unauthorized users cannot alter marks or attendance

title: Fast Persona / Demo Switcher
want: switch between Admin, Faculty, and Student personas with 1 click
soThat: stakeholders can easily evaluate role-specific features

title: Add / Register New Student Record
want: register a new student with demographic and academic attributes
soThat: their official university record is established

title: Search & Filter Student Directory
want: search students in real-time by name, ID, department, or status
soThat: I can locate any record in under a second

title: View Detailed Student Profile Modal
want: inspect a student's full profile with enrolled courses, attendance, and CGPA
soThat: I can counsel them on academic progress

title: Update Student Information
want: update student contact information and enrollment status
soThat: records remain up to date

title: Delete Student Record Safely
want: safely delete or deactivate erroneous student records with confirmation
soThat: accidental data loss is prevented

title: Add New Course Offering
want: create a new course offering with credits, department, and faculty
soThat: the curriculum catalog is maintained

title: Update Course Syllabus & Faculty
want: update course details or reassign instructors
soThat: faculty staffing changes are reflected accurately

title: Batch Assign Students to Course
want: batch enroll students into courses via an intuitive checklist
soThat: classroom rosters are established for attendance

title: View Course Roster Details
want: view all students enrolled in my course
soThat: I can plan classroom seating and lab groups

title: 1-Click Daily Attendance Recording
want: mark student attendance with 1-click 'Mark All Present' and toggle P/A/L
soThat: attendance is recorded in under 60 seconds

title: View Attendance Session Logs
want: browse historical attendance logs by date and topic
soThat: past lecture records can be audited

title: Student Attendance Compliance View
want: view my course attendance percentage with color status badges
soThat: I can stay above the 75% requirement

title: Course Attendance Summary Report
want: generate aggregate course attendance percentages
soThat: exam eligibility lists can be prepared

title: Enter Continuous Assessment Marks
want: enter internal (20), midterm (30), and end-sem (50) marks
soThat: all evaluation components are digitally stored

title: Automated Grade & GPA Calculation Engine
want: automatically calculate totals, letter grades (A-F), and GPAs
soThat: grading computation errors are eliminated

title: Printable Student Result Sheet / Transcript
want: generate a clean, printable official transcript card
soThat: students have official proof of semester performance

title: Low Attendance Alert Trigger (<75%)
want: trigger real-time alerts when student attendance falls below 75%
soThat: students and advisors can intervene early

title: Examination & Timetable Alerts
want: receive notifications of upcoming exam schedules and room allocations
soThat: I can prepare effectively

title: Result Publication Broadcast
want: receive a notification when final semester grades are published
soThat: I can check my transcript immediately

title: Executive Academic Analytics Dashboard
want: view interactive visual charts of enrollment, attendance, and grade spread
soThat: I can make informed institutional policy decisions

title: Export Data to CSV / Excel
want: export student, attendance, and mark records to CSV format
soThat: external university archiving compliance is met
